mcp-diff v0.1.0
Authority diff between two MCP server states. Black-box, never executes tools.

Usage:
  mcp-diff                          scan installed MCP configs, pin, diff-vs-pin
  mcp-diff [CONFIG_FILE...]         scan specific config files
  mcp-diff diff <A> <B>             authority diff between two explicit servers
  mcp-diff inspect [CONFIG...]      print declared manifests, no verdict
  mcp-diff whitelist <name> <hash>  allowlist a tool (writes .mcp-diff-ignore)
  mcp-diff pin [CONFIG...]          (re)record the baseline from current state

Flags:
  --json | --sarif                 output shortcuts
  --report-format=markdown|json|sarif
  --report-path=<file>             write report to a file instead of stdout
  --no-fail                        advisory: always exit 0
  --baseline-path=<file>           pin file (default: ~/.mcp-diff/baseline.json)
  --transport=stdio|http           transport for diff endpoints (default: stdio)
  --url-a=<url> --url-b=<url>       http endpoints for diff
  --timeout-ms=<n>                 total introspection budget (default: 30000)
  --request-timeout-ms=<n>         per-JSON-RPC-call budget (default: 10000)
  --help, -h                       print this help and exit 0

Exit codes:
  0 CLEAN   1 DENY   2 REVIEW   3 USAGE-error   4 introspection-error
